title: Detailed anchor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- anchor shank -->
  <rect x='46' y='18' width='8' height='56' rx='4' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <rect x='47' y='18' width='3' height='56' rx='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- stock (crossbar) -->
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='40' height='9' rx='4.5' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <rect x='30' y='22' width='40' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- ring at top -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#f1c40f' stroke-width='5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#f9e04c' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='14' r='8' fill='none' stroke='#d4ac0d' stroke-width='0.5'/>
  <!-- crown where shank meets arms -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='70' r='6' fill='#e8e8e8'/>
  <!-- left arm -->
  <path d='M46 64 Q28 64 20 78 Q18 84 24 84 Q30 84 32 80' fill='none' stroke='#c0392b' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 64 Q28 64 20 78' fill='none' stroke='#e74c3c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M54 64 Q72 64 80 78 Q82 84 76 84 Q70 84 68 80' fill='none' stroke='#c0392b' stroke-width='8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 64 Q72 64 80 78' fill='none' stroke='#e74c3c' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left fluke -->
  <path d='M24 84 Q14 92 10 84 Q12 76 20 78 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <path d='M10 84 Q12 79 20 79' fill='none' stroke='#f9e04c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- right fluke -->
  <path d='M76 84 Q86 92 90 84 Q88 76 80 78 Z' fill='#f1c40f'/>
  <path d='M90 84 Q88 79 80 79' fill='none' stroke='#f9e04c' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- bottom tip of shank -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='76' r='4' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- highlight marks on shank -->
  <rect x='48' y='30' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
  <rect x='48' y='44' width='2' height='6' rx='1' fill='#ffffff' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
